U. (रुणद्धि, रुन्द्धे, रुरोध, रुरुधे, अरुधत्-अरौत्सीत्-अरुद्ध, रोत्स्यति-ते, रोद्धुम्, रुद्ध; desid. रुरुत्सति-ते) 
__1 To obstruct, stop, arrest, check, oppose, hinder; impede, prevent; इदं रुणद्धि मां पद्ममन्तःकूजितषट्पदम् [[

.]] 
__2 To hold up, preserve, sustain (from falling); आशाबन्धः कुसुमसदृशं प्रायशो ह्यङ्गनानां सद्यःपाति प्रणयि हृदयं विप्रयोगे रुणद्धि [[

.]] 
__3 
___(a) To shut up, lock or block up, close up, shut or close; (with loc., but sometimes with two acc.); [[

.]] 
__5 To besiege, invest, blockade; रुन्धन्तु वारणधटा नगरं मदीयाः [[

.]] 
__6 To hide, cover, obscure, conceal. 
__7 To oppress, torment, afflict excessively. -Caus. 
__1 To cause to stop, detain, impede, obstruct. 
__2 To fetter, confine, chain. 
__3 To oppress, torment, harass. --
P. (रोधति) To grow, germinate; cf. रुह्.

]]] Red, red-coloured. 
-रम् 
__1 Blood. 
__2 Saffron. 
-रः 
__1 The red colour. 
__2 The planet Mars; रोहिणीशकटमर्कनन्दनश्चेद् भिनत्ति रुधिरोऽथवा शशी [[

.]] 
__3 A kind of precious stone. 
-Comp. 
-अन्धः N. of a hell. 
-अशनः ‘a blood-eater’, a demon, an evil spirit. 
-आख्यः a kind of precious stone. 
-आननम् one of the five retrograding motions of Mars. 
-आमयः hemorrhage, piles. 
-उद्गारिन् a. 
__1 emitting blood. 
__2 N. of a संवत्सर. 
-पायिन् m. a demon. 
-प्लावित a. soaked in blood. 
-लालस a. sanguinary. 
-लेपः a. spot of blood. 
-सार a. sanguine.
